page.overview:
Who is Ikelos?

Ikelos, also known as Phobeter, was one of the Oneroi and is the personification of nightmares that appear in various types of dreams. He made shapes of human-like entities appear in dreams.

Ikelos was a son of Nyx. He resided with his brothers, Morpheus and Phantasos in the Underworld. His appearance was that of a daemon, but he appeared in the form of animals and monsters when entering dreams, most commonly a lion or bear. Category:Underworld Gods
